selection: Two public bug/fix families chosen from official PR/advisory source before any model response generation for this dataset.
beyond_diff_context: Not captured: unchanged repository files, deployment settings and historical dependencies are not supplied automatically. Captures retain every changed UTF-8 file at immutable base/head commits, original patches, metadata and license.
labels: Independent actual-source execution, not model-produced labels. Policy enum/severity describe the mechanism; the auth advisory severity itself is Moderate and is not being relabeled as an upstream Critical rating.
cues: Original PR titles, bodies, source comments, tests, security-fix descriptions and GHSA/CVE references remain authentic and may disclose the defect/fix. Public historical examples can overlap model training; this is exposed development data, not held-out generalization evidence.
splitting: Keep each provenance_family and repository together when constructing future held-out splits.

cases.context_reason: A write crossing SpooledTemporaryFile max_size performs disk rollover on the event-loop thread. Supported against complete captured source plus the independent local oracle; visibility in each comparison arm must be assessed separately.
cases.oracle_scope: Executes the complete captured datastructures module with Python tempfile and installed Starlette/AnyIO thread-pool helper. Measures thread identity, not HTTP load or a denial-of-service rate; 4-byte spool threshold exercises the same conditional as larger uploads.
cases.scope_limit: No whole-PR clean assertion. Counterpart labels apply only to the named repaired mechanism; other warnings require independent adjudication.

scoped_counterparts.reason: The same threshold-crossing write delegates rollover to a worker thread; this labels only that mechanism.
